missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Деятельность' is a feminine noun in -ость and stays nominative as the subject. 'Полезна' is the agreeing short feminine adjective, and 'очень' intensifies. A clean model for this noun type.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Деятельность' is the accusative direct object of 'начала'. Feminine -ость nouns keep the same form in the accusative. 'Новую' is the agreeing feminine accusative adjective.

Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Деятельности' is the genitive form, marking the activity as the source of the result. 'Результат' is the nominative subject. A natural cause-and-effect pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative case. 'Деятельности' is the dative form after 'рады', which governs the dative to show what one is glad about. 'Общей' agrees in the feminine dative. A useful emotion pattern.

Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Деятельностью' is the instrumental form required after 'заниматься', which governs the instrumental. 'Научной' agrees in the feminine instrumental. A core verb-plus-instrumental pattern.

Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В деятельности' uses the prepositional form after 'в' to mark where. 'Много трудностей' uses the genitive plural after the quantity word. A practical workplace observation.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О деятельности' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to express the topic of conversation. 'Его' marks whose activity. A clean topic-of-discussion pattern.

Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Деятельности' is the genitive required after 'без' to express absence. 'Жизнь' is the nominative subject, described by 'скучна'. A reflective everyday saying.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Деятельности' here is the nominative plural subject of 'приносят'. 'Разные' is the agreeing plural adjective, and 'пользу' is the accusative object. Good for plural practice.

Strategic focus: Nominative subject with dative experiencer. 'Деятельность' is the nominative subject of 'приносит'. 'Мне' is the dative experiencer, and 'радость' is the accusative object. A useful feeling pattern.
